name: Vigil
author: keasbeexd
description: A security suite for Omarchy: hardening checks, malware and rootkit scanners, privacy settings and cleanup in one bar panel, with plain-language explanations and fixes you approve one by one. Runs locally and sends nothing anywhere.

barWidget.description: Security score in the bar; harden, scan, privacy and clean tabs in the panel

schema.label: Check every (minutes)
schema.description: How often Vigil re-reads your settings in the background. Checks are local, read-only and take well under a second.

schema.label: Notify about new findings
schema.description: Send one desktop notification when a check that was fine starts failing. The notification only says how many; details stay in the panel.
